name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) is not stated by the task and is a prerequisite already guaranteed by the environment. The task ‘Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal’ commands a hard ExistenceTwo(has_key) and a hard Existence(at_goal) with the stated order open the door before reach the goal. The environment constraint ‘door_open cannot become true before has_key’ already makes door_open impossible before has_key, so a Precedence(has_key, door_open) adds a requirement the sentence does not state. Remove the Precedence(has_key, door_open) clause; keep the hard ExistenceTwo(has_key), the hard Existence(at_goal) and the stated order Precedence(door_open, at_goal) which together already force door_open via the environment.

texts: Be holding the key on at least two different moves
Reach the goal only after the door is open
